entities.name: UniProt Q9EP52 (Tsg1)
observations: The 222-aa query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed mouse Twisted gastrulation protein homolog 1 (Q9EP52).
Annotated as a secreted BMP-pathway modulator that can antagonize BMP signaling via CHRD/BMP complexes and may also promote BMP signaling through CHRD degradation.
Pfam matches: Tsg_N (PF23782.2; residues 24–82) and Tsg (PF04668.18; residues 86–221).
Sequence-derived estimates: 24,800.4 Da; pI 5.29; instability index 60.21. These do not account for processing or modifications.
